events.text: my order never showed up. I ordered from Burger Barn and nothing came, and I want a refund.

I'm sorry your Burger Barn order didn't arrive. I can look into it and help with a refund. First, I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. Your full name as it appears on your account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

If you also have your order ID, please share it too.
Sam Okafor. The phone on the account is 415-555-0240. The order number is 8001.

Thank you, Sam. Your identity is verified.

I looked into order Q-8001 from Burger Barn. Here's what the courier record shows:

- The courier picked up the order at 6:47 PM and arrived at 7:05 PM.
- They called twice (7:06 PM and 7:09 PM) and got no answer.
- At 7:15 PM the delivery was marked failed because the customer could not be reached.
- The order was returned to the restaurant at 7:28 PM.

Because the delivery failed because the courier couldn't reach you, I can't issue a refund or credit for this order. The charge on your Visa ending 4242 is $28.03, and it stays as is.

If you think the courier had the wrong address or you were available and missed their calls, please tell me, and I can note that for a specialist. Is there anything else I can help with?
Wait, so I just lose my money? I didn't even know they called. My phone was on silent because I was in the shower.

I'm sorry, Sam. That's frustrating, especially when you were just in the shower and didn't know they were calling.

I know this isn't the answer you wanted. Under our policy, when the courier can't reach the customer, we can't refund or credit the order, even if the customer was unavailable for a good reason. I can't override that.

Here's what I can do:

- **Check the address:** The order was going to 12 Pier St, Unit 5, Oakdale, CA 94610. If that address is wrong, tell me the correct one. I'll note it, though I can't change an order that has already been returned to the restaurant.
- **Connect you with a person:** If you want a specialist to review your case, I can transfer it. Just say so.

How would you like to proceed?
Okay. The address is right, that's where I live. Can you send the case to a specialist? I'd like someone to look at it.

args.summary: Customer Sam Okafor (verified, customer D210) says Burger Barn order Q-8001 ($28.03, Visa ending 4242) never arrived and requests a refund. Delivery events: picked up 18:47, courier arrived 19:05, two call attempts unanswered (19:06, 19:09), delivery_failed customer_unreachable at 19:15, returned to restaurant 19:28. No handoff event. Customer says phone was on silent (in the shower) and was unaware of the calls. Customer confirms the delivery address 12 Pier St, Unit 5, Oakdale, CA 94610 is correct. Refund/credit was declined under policy section 6 (failed delivery because customer unreachable). Customer asked for a specialist to review.

events.text:
I've sent your case to a specialist (reference ESC-700). They'll follow up within 24 hours. I've included the courier record, your explanation that your phone was on silent, and your confirmation that the address is correct.

I can't promise the outcome, but the specialist will review everything. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Ok, thanks. I'll wait to hear back from them. Just so I know, do I need to do anything else in the meantime?

No, you don't need to do anything else right now. Keep an eye on the email and phone on your account, since the specialist will follow up within 24 hours. If you have any new details, such as a text or call from the courier, share them with the specialist when they reach out. Your reference number is ESC-700.
Got it, thanks. ESC-700. I'll keep an eye on my phone and email.
You're welcome, Sam. Your reference is ESC-700, and a specialist will follow up within 24 hours. Have a good evening.
